footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to CMS Energy: includes $69.0M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $10.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 13.6% to $8.5B in 2025. Gross margin was 70.5%, versus 73.7% a year earlier, and operating income rose 16.1% to $1.7B, a 20.2% margin.
Net income rose 6.8% to $1.1B, or $3.53 per share. Operating cash flow was $2.2B and free cash flow $1.6B, versus $1.9B.
sources: CMS Energy Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

CMS Energy and Consumers have financing needs and could be unable to obtain bank financing or access the capital markets
Market performance and other changes could decrease the value of employee benefit plan assets, which then could require substantial funding
